body:
I was a little uneasy about exchanging a lot of cash, so I decided to go with a gift card instead.
At emart24 I can use it the moment I arrive, and linking JPYC adds a discount, so for someone studying abroad who visits Korea often, this suited me better.
I just scanned the barcode to buy drinks and snacks at the convenience store. 10,000 won was gone in no time🛍️
Even though I'm not good with gadgets, I used it without any confusion, and I bought some tea with it at emart24. I was glad that simply linking my account added a discount😊

I have a family trip to Korea planned for September, so I bought this early as part of the preparations. I chose emart24 because they are all over town, so I can use it bit by bit on water, snacks, or daily necessities while walking around with my kids. Buying it with JPYC linked adds a discount, so even 10,000 won ended up costing a little less. The code arrived much sooner than I expected, and it was surprisingly simple. Just not having to wait in line at a currency exchange is a real help on a family trip. At the register I only need to show my phone screen and it goes right through, so I could pay without taking my eyes off my kids. The trip itself is still ahead, but with the preparations going this smoothly, I think we will be able to get around with peace of mind😊
10,000 won, a little cheaper thanks to the linking discount. I used it all up at a convenience store there. It was efficient👍

On my first day in Korea, I could buy drinks and snacks all at once at emart24 just by holding up the barcode, and that alone was easy😊
Linking JPYC adds a discount, so I got 10,000 won for a little less. The nice thing about convenience stores is that you can use them as soon as you arrive. I also got some points back, so I'm satisfied✨
